root_cause.text: The function `hvc_iucv_get_private()` uses a greater-than (`>`) comparison for bounds checking instead of greater-than-or-equal (`>=`), allowing an out-of-bounds index equal to the device count when `hvc_iucv_devices` reaches the maximum of 8.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `if (num > hvc_iucv_devices)` to `if (num >= hvc_iucv_devices)`. The CVE description and commit message state that if `hvc_iucv_devices == 8`, the original code permits access to `hvc_iucv_table[8]`, which is beyond the array's 8 entries (indices 0–7).
